detail: Stagg/El-Abiad 5-bus, 100MVA, 345kV; official MatACDC case5_stagg.m. Not MATPOWER case5 PJM.
Public standard IEEE14 via PYPOWER, whose case data originated from MATPOWER. Illinois reference links the same test system; authors final modified data not available.
P3 says load approximately five times initial. Reconstruction chooses exactly 5.0, retains original non-slack Pg, and does not fit reported voltages.

P3 specifies EPRI conductor/tower selection, 50km internal branches, but publishes only one Appendix geometry. Reconstruction extends the Appendix 500kV RLC to all 345kV internal branches, unity taps, no fixed shunts.
Two 1000km 500kV lines; 10Hz inferred from Appendix R10 and reported charging flows. Nominal-pi model selected. Frequency/model not explicitly stated for the case.
320kV, 1000km triangle known. Conductors and pole configuration not specified. Reconstruction uses R=.0265/2 ohm/km and single effective-pole DC equation; no calibration against Table5.
Printed Ic=Is+Vf/Zt uses transformer impedance in filter current. Fig4 KCL requires Ic=Is+Yf Vf.
Printed Zf=j.0887 conflicts with capacitive filter and reported results. Implement Yf=+j.0887 (equivalently Zf=-j/.0887), consistent with Fig4 and MatACDC convention.
Table4 says 1.010 pu; Table6 says 1.001 pu for the same DC bus.
Table4 says .993 pu / -.19 deg; Table7 says 1.003 pu / -.389 deg. The Table7 values coincide with Table4 bus15, despite Table2 and Fig6 specifying bus16.
Table4 gives 1.006 pu; Table6 gives 1.01 pu. Converter component checks evaluate both, without using them to fit the network.

The stated 1.05pu current bound is exceeded by the Table6/7 schedules under the common 100MVA interpretation that reproduces losses. Rating/base conversion or limit-switching details required. Flag violations; no claim of capability-feasible reproduction.
mmax=8 known; gammaMax and exact 25bus tolerance unknown. Use gammaMax1000, 1e-9 inner mismatch, 1e-8 outer DC interface mismatch. Preserve bus order; no fastmath.
Paper states data will be made available on request. No author data/code is bundled or publicly linked in the PDF; no message sent to authors.
